name: Portfolio
description: Crypto + cash portfolio value, priced live via NBP (PLN FX rates) and CoinGecko (crypto, keyless). Per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's Phase 6 note: this is the one module that's inherently personal rather than a generic 'anyone can plug in their own account' integration — stock positions (Tradegate/bankier-style sources) aren't included because those require fragile scraping or a headless browser; this integration deliberately sticks to reliable, keyless, documented APIs.
